skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the fundamental views of Marxism-Leninism on the working class and its historical mission, the content, manifestations, and significance of this mission in the current context.
Grasp the basic views of Marxism-Leninism on socialism, the transitional period to socialism, and the creative application of the Party's policies in Vietnam.
Recognize the essence of socialist democracy and the socialist state, and understand the social structure, class alliances, and ethnic and religious issues in the transitional period to socialism.
Understand the views of Marxism-Leninism, Ho Chi Minh, and the Communist Party of Vietnam on family issues in the transitional period to socialism.
Apply theoretical knowledge to analyze historical missions, socialist issues, and practical problems related to democracy, state, class alliances, ethnic and religious issues.
Work independently and in groups to solve problems.
Develop the ability to self-study and find materials to complete assignments.
Build confidence in socialism, support the policies of the Communist Party of Vietnam, and actively participate in political theory studies.
